race.comment: FLEETWOOD (4) has been good in his two runs back and should be hitting his straps now on the quick back-up. Gets in well at the weights with the rise in grade and is a distance specialist. Bold showing anticipated. POLYGLOT (6) was a good winner at Rosehill two back but couldn't quite follow it up when sent out favourite at Eagle Farm two weeks ago. Draws cosy on the inside and if he brings his best he'll take plenty of stitching. BAND OF BROTHERS (1) has been freshened and will be looking for a solid hit-out before he heads to try and conquer the mountain (Kozzy) next month. Certainly good enough to take care of them under the big weight. EPIC PROPORTIONS (2) has mixed his form since resuming but has the peaks to give this a big shake. Youngberry's 3kg claim strengthens his case if he brings his A-game. POWER OF THE BRAVE (7) has been below his best since resuming but has been freshened for 35 days. Holds genuine claims on best form and is one to keep safe.
